Localization.Name: Hornet Kiddie Ride
Localization.Description: Experience all the fun of flying a Hornet and none of the danger when you pilot this kiddie ride. Capturing the ship in miniature, the ride features the signature style of its full-sized counterpart while accentuating its undeniable charm.
